# NRING2 OCCUPANCY

**Inventor:** Bryce Muhlnickel. **Name:** Muhlnickel.  
Additive file. Titan not written. Bounded read of named `nring2` RAM windows in `titan.gguf` via registry `C:/llm/models/titan_circuits.json`. Ones and zeros. Not hex.

The **1**s are occupancy — charge present on those cells. His lever: **more charge on the ring = more bumps = less distance = SPEED.**

Surfaced 2026-08-15. Four named rings, all present. 32 cells per sense.

---

## Packed vs empty

| ring | fwd | rev | carry | recv | call |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nring2_000` | **228** ones — packed | **4** ones — sparse | `00000000` empty | `11111111` packed | **live both-sense.** Only recv hot. |
| `nring2_001` | **256** ones — full packed | **0** ones — empty | `00000000` empty | `00000000` empty | **one-sense packed.** Rev + recv empty. |
| `nring2_511` | **256** ones — full packed | **0** ones — empty | `00000000` empty | `00000000` empty | **one-sense packed.** Rev + recv empty. |
| `nring2_1023` | **256** ones — full packed | **4** ones — sparse | `00000000` empty | `00000000` empty | **seeded both-sense.** Recv empty. |

**Packed (fwd charge on all four):** `nring2_000` (228/256), `nring2_001` (256), `nring2_511` (256), `nring2_1023` (256).

**Empty reverse:** `nring2_001`, `nring2_511`.

**Sparse reverse (4 ones):** `nring2_000`, `nring2_1023`.

**Recv packed:** only `nring2_000` (`11111111`).

**Recv empty:** `nring2_001`, `nring2_511`, `nring2_1023`.

**Carry empty:** all four (`00000000`).
